children: Firelight launches on Flare on 6 October 2026, adding a protection layer for digital assets to the network's DeFi stack. Program operators can elect cover for the vaults they run, while stakers supply the capital that backs that cover.

The arrangement gives staking capital a use in vault protection and connects participating stakers with operators seeking cover. That new role could influence interest in FLR as investors weigh expectations of higher on-chain activity. The launch establishes the protection mechanism, but does not show how widely it will be used. Operators choose whether to take cover, so availability alone does not establish adoption.
A major new piece of Flare’s DeFi stack is about to go live, and the docs are already available for builders who want to understand the mechanics ahead of launch.

title: Flare: Firelight launches staker-backed DeFi protection - 06 Oct 2026
